images.prompt: Create ONE square printable children's mandala coloring page, a new illustration in the same cohesive series as the reference cat and octopus. Reference images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. Match their polished cute storybook drawing, bold smooth black outlines, large closed colorable spaces, decorative concentric circular border and appealing characters. White background, black line art only, no grayscale, no shading, no texture, no text or watermark. Complete circular composition with a white safety margin, nothing cropped. Keep foreground and background clearly separated with no erroneous intersecting lines. High resolution square master. Subject: a delightful woodland fairy-tale cottage, gently curved tiled roof, chimney, arched wooden front door, two rounded windows and one attic window. Short stepping stone path, two spotted mushrooms, a few flowers and leafy bushes. Charming substantial storybook detail, not a sparse schematic. Central scene occupies about two thirds of circle diameter. Three coherent decorative rings: small scallops, alternating diamonds and circles, outer broad pointed leaves. Preserve broad spaces for children to color. House has no face.
